validation.name: recorded tiny-DiT block calls replayed through MLX (float32): dit fixture scenarios av, rope_pos, video_only and dit_variants for the 7 non-released flag combinations
live torch vs MLX fused block with equal video/audio widths (16), all 8 (cross_gates, fix_modulation, ca_rope) combinations plus aud=None
live torch vs MLX encoder block, batch 2, with and without a per-row padding mask
deliberately inverted cross-modal gate swap (test-only monkeypatch of _cross_modal_gates)
validation.criterion: detected: rel_max > 1e-2 with equal widths, failure on the recorded fixture

validation.name: video head unpatchify element order (distinct integers)
audio head double norm
validation.criterion: with both norms rel_max <= 1e-4 vs recorded output; without the second norm rel_max > 1e-2

deviations.what: the fused block's per-modality steps live in two methods of Kandinsky6TransformerDecoderBlock (self_and_text_attention, feed_forward_residual), and the gate choice in Kandinsky6FusedTransformerDecoderBlock._cross_modal_gates
deviations.why: The video and audio paths are the same code in the reference, written twice; parameter paths are unchanged, and the gate method is the seam the swap-detection test patches. The order of operations follows the reference: the video text cross-attention residual is added only after the audio stream is updated, and cross-modal keys/values are the pre-cross-attention states.

deviations.what: the reference's .type_as(...) after each apply_gate_sum is not repeated
deviations.why: apply_gate_sum already returns the dtype of its first argument, which is the stream being cast to, so the cast is a no-op.

follow_ups: bf16 parity of the blocks is measured in spec 05 stage B against the float32 reference.
All reference branches were reachable with tiny configs: fix_modulation=False needs time_dim == time_dim_a, which the tiny config has; no stop condition was hit.

architecture_notes.note: Baseline fused block 2.24 s: video self-attention 1.84 s (82%), FFN 0.20 s (9%), text cross-attention 0.09 s, video-from-audio 0.07 s, audio-from-video 0.04 s, glue the rest. Smoke block 44 ms: self-attention 14 ms (32%), FFN 12.8 ms (29%), text cross-attention 6.9 ms, va 4.7 ms, av 2.7 ms (scripts/profile_components.py (real Lite-distill weights, bf16, M3 Max, 2026-10-31)).
architecture_notes.optimization: At Smoke size the work is spread out, so fusion and compilation help; at Baseline only attention matters.

architecture_notes.note: va/av attention use aud_pre_ca and vis_pre_ca as keys/values, so they do not depend on the text cross-attention result.
architecture_notes.optimization: Text cross-attention and the two cross-modal attentions of a block are independent and could be scheduled concurrently.

architecture_notes.note: Audio has 45-218 tokens of width 896; av attention (audio queries over 50 220 video keys) is 39 ms at Baseline.
